a.speaker: narration
a.text: The office smells like wet dog, whiskey and old film stock. Every monitor in the room is showing her.

b.speaker: arlo
b.text: Sit down, kid. You're blocking channel four.

d.speaker: arlo
d.text: Watched? I had money on you. Sergeant Biscuits had money on the dogs. Biscuits is gonna be unbearable.

e.speaker: arlo
e.text: The network sends the dog food. Premium. By the pallet. Nobody sends a stunt coordinator steak out of kindness, Cass. They were fattening up the set.

choices.text: You were there. You let it happen.

w1.speaker: arlo
w1.text: The gag was clean when I checked it at midnight. Pads, bars, two extinguishers. Full ones. I lifted them myself.

l1.speaker: arlo
l1.text: I was there. Asleep in the truck with the heater on, because the Director swore the shot was scrubbed till dawn.

l2.speaker: arlo
l2.text: I woke up to the light. You ever see a fire through a windshield? Looks like a sunrise on the wrong side of the sky.

w2.speaker: arlo
w2.text: Three in the morning, Dutch Kowalski walked back out to that car with a toolbox. Dutch. Our pyro. They call him the Fireman now.

x.speaker: arlo
x.text: Dutch does effects for KHSC these days. Stage Nine, Burbank. That new show. The one your brother's in.

z.speaker: arlo
z.text: Friday, eleven P.M. They're cutting his last take into the premiere. I've seen the promo. They put a laugh track on the part where he's screaming.

v.speaker: arlo
v.text: And Vance. Aurelio. My kid brother. When we were boys he'd burn ants with a magnifying glass. Said the sun did it. He just held the lens.

v2.speaker: arlo
v2.text: That's the whole business, Cass. Somebody else always holds the lens.

r.speaker: narration
r.text: A small red dot drifts across the whiskey bottle. The desk. His chest. He sees it before she does.

r3.speaker: narration
r3.text: The window goes white. Out in the yard, every dog stops barking at once.

r4.speaker: voice
r4.text: Episode two is in the can, hotshot. Get some sleep. Friday is the big one.
